_comment: Every number is from the same 2,000-chunk corpus, 46 questions split 27 dev / 19 held out. The held-out half was never used to choose a setting. Regenerate the charts with scripts/charts.py.

held_out.note: not shipped: needs an extra dependency; kept as a record

dev.note: not shipped: needs an extra dependency; kept as a record

rejected.change: Short context line above every passage
Session topic instead of full context
Keyword boosting across the whole corpus

abandoned.why: ~3x the cost per search; on a 6-core CPU it did not clear ten questions in 46 minutes
~0.8 passages/s on a 4GB card, ~2.7 hours for one index; and the oracle showed recall was not the constraint
